description: This file defines a CMake macro function named `compile_aidl` to generate source code from AIDL files during the build process, supporting configuration options such as language, include directories, target output directory, and additional AIDL compiler flags.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake macro to compile AIDL files into source code with configurable options such as language, include directories, output directory, and flags.
